title: Great Learning
bio: Indian online education company offering professional courses in data science, artificial intelligence and management with university partners, plus free courses.

title: greytHR
bio: greytHR provides cloud-based HR and payroll software for small and medium-sized businesses in India and other countries.

title: GulfTalent
bio: GulfTalent is an online recruitment platform listing professional jobs in the Gulf countries and connecting employers with experienced candidates.

title: Gusto
bio: Gusto provides online payroll, benefits and HR software for small and medium-sized businesses in the United States.

title: JetBrains
bio: JetBrains makes software development tools, including IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm and other code editors, and created the Kotlin programming language.

title: Jimdo
bio: German website builder that helps small businesses create and host websites and online stores using templates.

title: Jobberman
bio: Jobberman is an online job platform in Nigeria and Ghana that connects job seekers with employers and offers recruitment services.

title: Kahoot!
bio: Norwegian learning platform that lets teachers, trainers and users create and play game-based quizzes in classrooms, workplaces and at home.

title: Keka
bio: Keka provides HR and payroll software covering attendance, leave, performance reviews and hiring for businesses in India and abroad.

title: Klook
bio: Booking platform for tours, attractions, activities and local transport.

title: KOHO
bio: KOHO is a Canadian financial app offering a prepaid card, spending account, savings, credit building and budgeting tools.

title: Konga
bio: Konga is a Nigerian online marketplace selling electronics, phones, fashion and household goods with delivery across Nigeria.

title: Kraken
bio: US cryptocurrency exchange for trading crypto assets.

title: KuCoin
bio: Cryptocurrency exchange listing a wide range of coins.

title: Lalamove
bio: Hong Kong-based on-demand delivery app that connects customers with drivers of motorcycles, vans and trucks for same-day deliveries.

title: Ledger
bio: Ledger makes hardware wallets and companion software that let users store cryptocurrency private keys offline and manage digital assets.

title: Lime
bio: Electric scooter and bike sharing service available in many cities.
